programs.description: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.
The police are out on the hunt for a serial killer who targets beautiful women. Their luck changes when a woman who is in love with one of the suspects joins the search.
Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal.
Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.
Vikram and Pratap, two young friends, live harmoniously. However, things get complicated when Pratap's sister is raped and murdered, and Pratap sets out to exact revenge.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.
A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth.
The universe offers a Banjara tribe leader's daughter an opportunity to turn her doomed love story into a happily-ever-after with her soulmate.
Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.

Ram begins to suspect that his wife, Seeta, is having an affair with his brother, Amar. His doubts persist even after Amar gets married, creating problems within his family.
Lovers Payal and Chetan elope as their families disapprove of their relationship. They start a new life working for Geeta, unaware of her true nature and affiliations.
While filming a documentary in a prison, Chandrika comes across three unique stories and, somewhere in between, finds what her heart has been seeking.
Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.

After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.
Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.

programs.showName: Rafoo Chakkar: Fun on the Run
programs.description: Two brothers, Manjeet and Parmeet, run away from their home in order to avoid getting married. Eventually, they lead a life of crime and things take a turn when they get arrested.
A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper.
A jailer's daughter falls for a prisoner poet, believing him wrongly convicted and strives to prove his innocence and secure his release.

A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.
Aslam, a villager who runs a small business, accidentally meets the Prime Minister of India, who grants him special security on his request. Soon, he starts chasing political ambitions.
After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.

India 1982; Romance; Dir. Sai Paranjpye; Cast: Farooq Shaikh, Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval. Rajaram, a middle-class clerk, is secretly in love with his neighbour, Sandhya, but is too shy to disclose his love. He is shocked when his smooth-talking friend comes visiting and soon woos Sandhya.
Inder and Pallavi fall for each other but her three possessive brothers hate him. Resultantly, the couple elopes, but they soon find themselves missing their families and decide to return.
Sitaram refuses to accept his son Vasudev's marriage to Suman. Years later, he eagerly awaits their return from the USA but is left disheartened when his granddaughter Sita turns up alone.
An aspiring screenwriter becomes involved in a diamond heist while writing a script for his film and struggles to evade the police.
Anwar, a Muslim boy, falls in love with a Hindu girl who rejects him and elopes with his best friend. Post her death, a misunderstanding leads the police to believe that he is a terrorist.

programs.showName: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programs.description: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan.
When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her.

Rajkumar's mother sets out to oppose his marriage after she finds out that he plans to marry the rival kingdom's princess.
A slum-dwelling performer finds a new calling as a rising disco star. However, things take an unfortunate turn when an enemy from the past reappears in his life.
Chhalia, a simple-minded man, tries to help and falls for Shanti, an ill-fated woman affected by partition. However, things become complicated when her turbulent personal life unfolds.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.
Aditya finds himself on an island after surviving a shipwreck. Here, he realises he is a giant amongst its inhabitants, who think he is going to save them from a terrifying demon.
Vipul and Saurabh, two friends, decide to put an end to the misery of couples by starting a love hotel. However, the local political group is not in favour of their venture.
Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
Twin brothers Raja and Prem Malhotra get separated at birth but are reunited by fate to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.
Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.
Veeru and Dheeru live under the tyrant ruler, Raja Jaichand. Later, they embark on a mission and strive to overcome challenges to defeat the dictator.
Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
In the aftermath of Gujarat's violent 2002 riots, victims find their lives changed forever and reel from the deep impact the upheaval left on them.
Durga, a simple village girl, watches her entire family die at the hands of Thakur. Soon, she picks up the gun and chooses a criminal lifestyle to avenge the death of her loved ones.
When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.
Raja, a taxi driver, falls in love with Aarti, a rich girl and marries her against her parents' wishes. Later, her stepmother tries to create differences between the couple.
A woman is held captive by a group of kidnappers to compel her MI5 husband to exterminate the prime minister of the country.

Two individuals fall in love and marry against their parents' wishes. However, their life takes a dramatic turn when the woman is diagnosed with a life-threatening disease.
Mangal Singh escapes prison and begins a new life, unknowingly befriending his victim's family. As he seeks redemption, his past catches up, compelling him to confront his previous misdeeds.
Two siblings drift apart after one of them disapproves of the other's blooming romance with an unknown woman. Eventually, fate reunites them under unexpected circumstances.
Rajesh, the superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend, Shekar, in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler, who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.
Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.
Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna.
A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.
Three roommates decide to solve their financial struggles by going down the path of crime and kidnapping people for small ransoms.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.
Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.

Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly become a part of an awful terrorist plot to kill a minister.
A devout Muslim Indian man is tasked with repairing a lorry in order to transport the ashes of Mahatma Gandhi. However, when communal violence strikes, he is left with a troubling dilemma.
Adarsh and Aniket are two brothers who study in the same college. However, when they graduate and plan to establish a career, both of them choose different paths and gradually drift apart.
A suspended policeman, Vikram Dixit, along with his wife, looks for Fredrick, the prime suspect in his sister's kidnapping. However, he cannot find anybody who knows him or has seen him in a while.
After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.
Vijay and Ajay make a living by stealing money from people. Their friendship is affected when Vijay discovers that Ajay's father may have been his father's killer.
Frustrated with his wife, Namdev, a businessman, decides to end his life. However, things take a turn when he envisions his dead father who encourages him to rethink his decision.
After a big fight with his nagging wife Nikki, Purushottam Tripathi, an aspiring writer, leaves his home. However, his life takes a drastic turn when he meets Rubina, a prostitute.
A man is determined to prove his lover's innocence after she is suddenly accused of murdering his family.
After being diagnosed with alopecia, a condition that causes rapid hair loss, Enakshi, a young girl, navigates through the trials and tribulations of life.

Pandit Girdhari Laal Sharma wants to get his daughter, Radha, married extravagantly but lacks the money for it. He then devises a plan to source the money, unaware of the consequences.
After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.
A nurse receives praise for taking care of a coma patient. However, after the nurse gets married, tragedy quickly befalls him.
Daksh, a singing sensation, falls for Aarika, who is unaware of his drug addiction. Things take a turn when his inclination towards drugs comes to light.
A man marries his lover and has a child with her against the wishes of her wealthy father. However, his scheming father-in-law ruins their marriage and leaves to care for his boy by himself.
Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them.
When Amba Prasad realises the harsh truth that his relatives just care for his money, he leaves home. Upon reaching a village, he meets Arun and Aarti and his life changes forever.
Arjun Pratap Singh, an IPS officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges and embarks on a mission to restore peace in society.
Badshah Khan travels to India to behead the man who killed Benazir's father and win her hand in marriage. He succeeds in his mission but is caught by Ranveer Singh, a jailer.
Imran, a freelance photographer, meets Asiya, a mysterious woman, on his way to Alipur for an assignment. However, things take a turn when he repeatedly sees her and starts to question reality.
